signature.name: VTask.ofAddValuation
signature.type: {R : Type u_3} -> {Γ₀ : Type u_5} -> [Ring R] -> [LinearOrderedCommMonoidWithZero Γ₀] -> AddValuation R (Additive Γ₀)ᵒᵈ ≃ Valuation R Γ₀

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: VTask.ofAddValuation is a total equivalence with no junk-value or boundary conventions; every additive valuation of the specified type maps to a well-defined multiplicative valuation.

facts.statement: ∀ (R : Type*) (Γ₀ : Type*) [Ring R] [LinearOrderedCommMonoidWithZero Γ₀] (v : AddValuation R (Additive Γ₀)ᵒᵈ) (r : R), VTask.ofAddValuation v r ≠ OrderDual.ofDual (v r)
